integrity: Analytic all-dimensional proof and a standalone independent finite rational-density verification are supplied. The numerical asymptotic checks are corroborative only; no independent scientific validation has been performed.
limitations: Applies to one uniform-measure affine parallelepiped cell and the complete space of affine functions. Does not cover globally coupled finite-element projection, tensor-product multilinear spaces, weighted least squares, general convex cells, or higher polynomial degree. Historical priority is provisional.
title: Sharp affine least-squares amplification on parallelepipeds and a dimension-five positivity threshold
